name: risk-threshold
description:
A server that ignores the min_risk_meter_score query parameter. The parameter is not a documented /assets/search filter, so the script cannot rely on it alone: this fixture returns one asset above the configured threshold and one below it in the same page, exactly what a server that ignored the filter would send. The below-threshold asset must be dropped client-side and counted, the above-threshold asset must import, and the parameter must still be sent so a server that does honor it saves the transfer.

check_determinism is off because the Kenna asset id is scoped by the API host AND port and the fixture server binds a fresh random port on each run.

log_contains: kenna: skipped 1 assets below the configured minimum risk meter score
